sanskrit_verse: अक्षताभिः सपुष्पाभिर् मूर्धन्य एनम् अवाकिरेत् । अदास इति चोक्त्वा त्रिः प्राङ्मुखं तम् अथोत्सृजेत् ॥
transliteration: akṣatābhiḥ sapuṣpābhir mūrdhany enam avākiret | adāsa iti coktvā triḥ prāṅmukhaṃ tam athotsṛjet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must sprinkle unbroken rice mixed with flowers upon the head of the person who has committed a transgression, declare 'it is given' three times facing east, and then release them.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The act is performed by one possessing ritual and spiritual capacity.
Causation: Ritual action initiates purification through symbolic offering.
Capacity-based responsibility: The agent must possess awareness to perform the act correctly.
Restoration logic: The process restores purity and removes karmic residue without inflicting harm.
Consciousness alignment: Directional orientation (eastward) aligns the individual with ascending consciousness.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent performs a transgression THEN execute purification ritual using akṣatā and puṣpa directed toward the head.
IF declaration 'adāsa' is spoken three times facing east THEN release the purified entity immediately.
IF directional misalignment occurs during ritual THEN repeat until correct orientation is maintained.
IF consciousness of the purified individual shows disturbance post-ritual THEN initiate follow-up completion protocol.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court-level adjudication, this verse establishes that restoration must be enacted through precise ritual form, not punitive measures. The court's role is to ensure correct execution of dharma-based purification, affirming the accused's reintegration into societal and cosmic order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via ritual correctness; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests in sequential steps—sprinkling, declaration, release. Responsibility lies in proper performance, not infliction of suffering. Proportionality aligns with the gravity of transgression as determined by Vedic causality.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Akṣatā-Puṣpa Purification Process under supervision of qualified officiant.
Ensure tri-directional confirmation of 'adāsa' utterance with audio verification.
Monitor consciousness state of released individual for 24-hour integration period.
Deploy Nyāyānanda Protocol to verify energetic alignment post-release.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure restoration, excludes all punitive intent, affirms consciousness as the ultimate judge, and upholds reality as inherently non-punitive.
